wbs.description: Move shared runtime resources and private lookup policy with compatibility re-exports

testImpact.isolation: Serial local verification with valueless fixtures; preserve existing route tests and run no paid providers.

risks: Preserve process-global identity across core/web modules and reloads; require complete isolated ResourceContext.
Move the existing executable closure without provider algorithm changes or dependency upgrades.
Retain fixed private origin/path validation and redirect refusal with real local HTTP coverage.
Stop and split if the converged total or complete scope cannot remain strictly below four hours; never reduce inputs merely to pass.
